label: challenging behaviour
definition: the study's own challenging-behaviour code list (Millington 2026 supplementary file 1)

label: emergency or out-of-hours contact
definition: A&E attendance codes; out-of-hours consultation; ambulance attendance

label: injury
definition: injury and self-harm codes recorded in primary care

label: psychotropic start or increase
definition: new issue or dose increase of an antipsychotic; antidepressant; anxiolytic; hypnotic (excluding melatonin); or anticonvulsant used for mood
source_to_use: study team (dose increase needs quantity/strength logic)

label: anticholinergic
definition: drugs with high anticholinergic burden (e.g. oxybutynin; tricyclics; hyoscine)

label: melatonin
source_to_use: record as covariate; the panel flagged its start date as a possible confounder
